note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026), Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahwealj992) and average post-tax disposable income (adiincj992) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. The database's metadata leaves the figures' currency blank; its market exchange rate in local currency per US dollar (xlcusxi999), whose metadata says of 1960 to 2024 "Currency assumed to be USD", is 1 for 2024, so they are read as USD, as the database's own rates state them to be. Read 2026-10-31.
